rule: Coalesce only reviewed components connected by matching full-definition bridges. Same source varnumber, same storage type, zero observed conflicts, and compatible bridge-year code labels are required. Description normalization preserves relative year offsets and removes only exact perturbation notice from concept comparison, while preserving that notice and all annual definitions in evidence. This combines source lanes and does not assert time-invariant measurement.
execution_guards: Every source column must exist; no target collision.
No addition or averaging. Coalesce only actual nulls. Preserve sentinel codes and observed empty strings until separate metadata-driven cleaning.
Abort on any two nonnull unequal values within a proposed component. All approved source lanes currently have disjoint observed years.
Preserve every row and exactly one source value for each nonmissing consolidated cell.
Carry annual dictionary and value-label records by source/year; do not force a universal label when definitions/codes vary.
Preserve component-specific PRCH/IDX/allocation flags and perturbation/formula breaks.
Retain nonapproved source lanes and every substantive variable.
